findings: Desktop shows the saved-image animation at its sampled offset/rotation/scale/opacity, with a distinct unchanged second instance and stable logical labels.
Playback and stop-to-static controls are clearly separated from the disabled layout author action.
English and Japanese at 390px keep readable controls and a focused time input without horizontal overflow; longer Japanese guidance uses normal vertical scrolling.
During an active visual frame, both the canvas help and empty-selection prompt direct users to the object list. Stopping restores the original canvas-picking guidance.
limitations: The captured viewport is a real headless Chrome local HTTP editor, not installed Tauri or Android.
The object outline abbreviates identities as before this change; animation targeting itself uses exact immutable instance IDs.
The preview is saved visual animation only, without behavior/physics/audio/replay/frame animation or composition playback.
